content.body:
An asterisk (*) next to a rank in the Position column indicates the individual player has enabled his Squad Recruiting flag (from Squad Options tab).
Recruit a player to your squad (must be Recruiter rank in Squad or above) /RECRUIT
Accept an invitation to join a squad. /ACCEPT
Decline an invitation to join a squad (Invitations also eventually time out.) /DECLINE
Leave your current squad. /LEAVE
Disband your squad (CO rank only). /DISBAND
Remove a player from the squad (X0 rank and above). /REMOVE
Promote a player up one rank - Maximum 1 rank below (X0 rank and above). /PROMOTE
Demote a player one rank - limited to players below your level (X0 rank and above). /demote
Resign your command (CO only). Demotes you to XO and makes the CO. /RESIGN
